in_marathi.name: Purva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे First, Foremost, Ancient
in_marathi.long_meaning: Purva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Purva means 'the first, foremost, ancient'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'pur', which means 'first' or 'foremost'. In Hindu mythology, Purva is the name of the wife of the god Brahma, and also of one of the 27 stars in the constellation of the Pleiades.
